description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag 'ShopProductPriceFormatTag' used to format product prices with currency for display in a web application. It interacts with pricing and currency services and outputs the formatted price to the JSP page.

classes.name: ShopProductPriceFormatTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class used for formatting product prices with optional currency for display purposes.

methods.name: doStartTagInternal
methods.description: Initializes dependencies if not autowired, retrieves store context from request, determines formatted price based on currency, and writes output to page.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Returns evaluation constant to continue page evaluation.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the price value to be formatted.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves the set currency for formatting.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for price formatting.
